data.name: Combat Trick / Arcane Armor Mastery
data.description: When casting a spell while wearing armor, you can spend 1 stamina point to activate Arcane Armor Mastery as a free action, or spend a number of stamina points equal to the spell's level (minimum 1) to ignore your armor's arcane spell failure chance entirely for that casting.
